decisions.rationale: Article/rate/quantity branches and a/an sound rule are already coherent and high-value.
Current object already separates abandonment senses and preserves with abandon as a hidden idiom.
Single ordinary anatomical sense with no hidden learner boundary.
Two modern construction-bound branches are already explicit and well summarized.
Single capacity sense plus to-infinitive construction is already learner-ready.
Ability vs competent-person branch and be able to construction are already clear.
Single ordinary abnormality sense; bounded domain phrase does not require richer default Depth.
Upgraded the grammatical mental model so adverb/preposition uses and no-extra-preposition rule are directly learnable.
Single formal abolition sense; no missing hidden branch.
Existing subject-frame distinction (things abound vs container abounds in/with) is already strong.
Polysemy and high-value constructions are already organized by the around/near model.
Spatial/threshold/text branches are already unified by a useful upward-axis model.
Location-adverb rule and from abroad exception are already explicit.
Event/manner/slope branches are already unified by no-gradual-transition.
Person absence vs condition/evidence absence and their constructions are already explicit.
Physical/mental/formal-verb branches and from pattern are already coherent.
Upgraded from gloss-level 'absolute/complete' to an endpoint/no-limiting-condition model.
Five branches already share a strong take-in/take-on model with reusable constructions.
Current object already separates adjective/noun/verb abstraction and form distinctions.
Single ordinary absurdity sense; existing pattern is sufficient without extra Depth burden.
Single abundance sense with abundant in pattern; no hidden branch requiring more content.
Current object already covers misuse/abuse/verbal branches and noun/verb pronunciation boundary.
Scholarly vs purely theoretical vs person branch is already high-quality.
Upgraded the institution/society split into one specialist-domain organizing model.
Upgraded transitive/intransitive speed-up model so process acceleration transfers across contexts.
Upgraded accent from gloss list to one prominence model spanning pronunciation, stress, mark and emphasis.
Upgraded accept into an object-driven branch map: receive, agree, admit truth, take responsibility, tolerate.
Upgraded acceptance with branch model and reusable of/into/gain constructions.
Upgraded access around a boundary-crossing model and the noun access to vs verb access sth grammar split.
Upgraded physical accessory vs criminal accessory around principal-vs-secondary relation; added legal constructions.
Upgraded accident around unplanned/unintended, separating harmful event from by accident manner.
Noun/verb share one enthusiastic-public-praise meaning; current object is already sufficient.
Upgraded accommodate around making room for people/needs/differences and clarified production preference.
Upgraded accommodation around lodging vs adjustment/compromise and added reusable constructions.
Upgraded accompany around together-with across person, phenomenon and music branches.
Single successful-completion sense; current examples are sufficient.
Upgraded accord into agreement/grant frames and surfaced the four high-value constructions.
Upgraded accordance as a construction-bound noun centered on in accordance with.
Upgraded accordingly by separating action-modifying 'correspondingly' from clause-linking 'therefore'.
Current account object already has a strong say/count model and the high-risk account for cause/proportion split.
Single profession noun with adequate fixed terms.
Single gradual accumulation sense covering transitive/intransitive examples.
Single accuracy concept with adequate learner use for this pass.
Single accurate concept with ordinary examples; no hidden branch in current scope.
Upgraded mental model around accusation frame and accuse of vs charge with boundary.
Upgraded accustom with repeated-exposure model and explicit prepositional to + noun/V-ing rule.
Upgraded ache by unifying dull pain and longing through persistent-pull model.
Single successful-achievement sense; no missing hidden branch.
Upgraded acid by making the chemistry→figurative biting extension explicit.
Upgraded acknowledge into complement-driven communicative acts and added receipt/help constructions.
